item.title: The US “democracy” is very much like student govt: gets some say in some things some times
item.description:
The US “democracy” is very much like student govt: gets some say in some things some times. But MUCH more important than what they are choosing to say is who is choosing what things they are allowed to have a say in. Who sets the parameters of discussion, oligarchs and billionaires.

item.title: There is a 1-1 relationship between the American corporate media and corporations interests
item.description:
There is a 1-1 relationship between the American corporate media and corporations interests. It’s not bias, it’s not influence, it’s not corruption. It’s the function of the system as a whole, so use it how it’s helpful, but don’t confuse urself for what it is
